mifid-ii-art25-suitability.title: MiFID II — Article 25: Suitability and Appropriateness
mifid-ii-art25-suitability.summary: Investment firms must assess suitability of investment services and financial instruments for clients.

mifid-ii-art27-best-execution.title: MiFID II — Article 27: Best Execution
mifid-ii-art27-best-execution.summary: Investment firms must take sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result for clients when executing orders.

mar-art10-information-barrier.title: MAR — Article 10: Information Barriers (Chinese Wall)
mar-art10-information-barrier.summary: Prohibition on unlawful disclosure of inside information. Information barriers required between research and trading.

mar-art12-market-manipulation.title: MAR — Article 12: Market Manipulation
mar-art12-market-manipulation.summary: Defines market manipulation including wash trading, spoofing, and layering.

mar-art16-str-filing.title: MAR — Article 16: STR Filing Obligation
mar-art16-str-filing.summary: Operators of trading venues and investment firms must report suspicious orders and transactions.

sfdr-art4-adverse-impact.title: SFDR — Article 4: Principal Adverse Impacts
sfdr-art4-adverse-impact.summary: Financial market participants must publish statements on principal adverse sustainability impacts.

sfdr-art8-disclosure.title: SFDR — Article 8: Environmental/Social Promotion Disclosure
sfdr-art8-disclosure.summary: Products promoting environmental or social characteristics must disclose how those characteristics are met.

eu-taxonomy-regulation.title: EU Taxonomy Regulation
eu-taxonomy-regulation.summary: Classification system for environmentally sustainable economic activities.

eu-ai-act-art12-traceability.title: EU AI Act — Article 12: Record-Keeping (Traceability)
eu-ai-act-art12-traceability.summary: High-risk AI systems must enable automatic recording of events (logs) for traceability.

eu-ai-act-art15-robustness.title: EU AI Act — Article 15: Accuracy, Robustness, Cybersecurity
eu-ai-act-art15-robustness.summary: High-risk AI systems must achieve appropriate levels of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity.

eu-ai-act-art52-transparency.title: EU AI Act — Article 52: Transparency (AI Disclosure)
eu-ai-act-art52-transparency.summary: AI systems interacting with natural persons must disclose that fact. Content must be marked as AI-generated.

gdpr-art5-integrity-confidentiality.title: GDPR — Article 5(1)(f): Integrity and Confidentiality
gdpr-art5-integrity-confidentiality.summary: Personal data must be processed in a manner ensuring appropriate security, including protection against unauthorised or unlawful processing.

gdpr-art22-automated-decisions.title: GDPR — Article 22: Automated Individual Decision-Making
gdpr-art22-automated-decisions.summary: Data subjects have the right not to be subject to fully automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects.

sec-advisers-act-fiduciary.title: SEC Investment Advisers Act — Fiduciary Duty
sec-advisers-act-fiduciary.summary: Investment advisers owe fiduciary duties of care and loyalty to clients.

sec-rule-204-2-books-records.title: SEC Rule 204-2: Books and Records
sec-rule-204-2-books-records.summary: Investment advisers must make and keep records of transactions, communications, and advisory activities.

sec-rule-204a-insider-trading.title: SEC Rule 204A-1: Insider Trading Compliance
sec-rule-204a-insider-trading.summary: Investment advisers must establish, maintain, and enforce insider trading policies and procedures.

reg-nms-rule611-trade-through.title: Reg NMS — Rule 611: Trade-Through Prohibition
reg-nms-rule611-trade-through.summary: Trading centers must establish policies to prevent trade-throughs (executing at prices inferior to NBBO).

reg-fd-fair-disclosure.title: Regulation FD — Fair Disclosure
reg-fd-fair-disclosure.summary: Issuers must make simultaneous public disclosure of material nonpublic information disclosed to market professionals.

finra-3110-supervisory-system.title: FINRA Rule 3110: Supervisory System
finra-3110-supervisory-system.summary: Broker-dealers must establish and maintain a system to supervise activities of associated persons.

sox-section302-information-barriers.title: SOX — Section 302: Corporate Responsibility for Financial Reports
sox-section302-information-barriers.summary: Officers must certify accuracy of financial reports and effectiveness of internal controls, including information barriers.

sox-section404-internal-controls.title: SOX — Section 404: Internal Controls Assessment
sox-section404-internal-controls.summary: Management must assess effectiveness of internal controls over financial reporting.

ica-rule22c1-nav-publication.title: Investment Company Act — Rule 22c-1: NAV Pricing
ica-rule22c1-nav-publication.summary: Registered investment companies must compute NAV at least once daily and sell/redeem shares at that price.

csdr-art7-settlement-discipline.title: CSDR — Article 7: Settlement Discipline
csdr-art7-settlement-discipline.summary: CSDs must have procedures to facilitate settlement on the intended settlement date (T+1/T+2).

emir-clearing-reconciliation.title: EMIR — Clearing and Reconciliation Obligations
emir-clearing-reconciliation.summary: OTC derivative counterparties must clear through CCPs and reconcile positions.

dora-operational-resilience.title: DORA — Digital Operational Resilience Act
dora-operational-resilience.summary: Financial entities must maintain digital operational resilience including ICT risk management, incident reporting, and testing.

erisa-prudent-investor.title: ERISA — Prudent Investor Rule
erisa-prudent-investor.summary: Fiduciaries must act with the care, skill, prudence, and diligence of a prudent person.

asc-820-fair-value.title: ASC 820: Fair Value Measurement
asc-820-fair-value.summary: Defines fair value, establishes a framework for measuring fair value (Level 1/2/3 hierarchy).

ifrs-13-fair-value.title: IFRS 13: Fair Value Measurement
ifrs-13-fair-value.summary: Defines fair value and provides a single framework for measuring fair value across IFRS standards.

basel-iii-capital-requirements.title: Basel III: Capital Requirements Framework
basel-iii-capital-requirements.citation: Basel III: A global regulatory framework
basel-iii-capital-requirements.summary: Global framework for bank capital adequacy, stress testing, and market liquidity risk.

dodd-frank-risk-reporting.title: Dodd-Frank Act — Title VII: Risk Reporting
dodd-frank-risk-reporting.citation: Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act, Title VII
dodd-frank-risk-reporting.summary: Comprehensive regulation of OTC derivatives, swap reporting, and systemic risk monitoring.

aifmd-risk-management.title: AIFMD — Risk Management Requirements
aifmd-risk-management.summary: AIFMs must implement adequate risk management systems, including VaR limits and stress testing.
